scope_note: Core corpus of Tamil Nadu policies, strategies and schemes that directly target industrial production, investment, exports, industrial employment, R&D or industrial infrastructure. Cross-cutting tourism, organic farming, general PPP and general social policies on the Guidance portal are outside scope. Policy notes are implementation evidence, not policies.
